name: @zaimokuza/atlassian-server-mcp
description: Unified stdio MCP server for Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket Data Center

scripts.prepack: node scripts/check-pinned-deps.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm operations:check && pnpm policy:check && pnpm inventory:check
scripts.package:smoke: node scripts/clean.mjs && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:contract: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.contract.config.ts
scripts.test:ci: node scripts/check-pinned-deps.mjs && node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js . && node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check . && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node scripts/clean.mjs && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --coverage && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.contract.config.ts && node scripts/generate-e2e-coverage.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-operations.mjs --check && node rule/fetch-api-inventory.mjs --offline --check && node rule/build-policy.mjs --check && node scripts/check-env-docs.mjs && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs
scripts.e2e:jira: pnpm build && node scripts/e2e.mjs jira test
scripts.e2e:confluence: pnpm build && node scripts/e2e.mjs confluence test
scripts.e2e:bitbucket: pnpm build && node scripts/e2e.mjs bitbucket test
scripts.e2e:all: pnpm build && node scripts/e2e.mjs all test
